glossary.definition: (1) "Architect" means an individual who is certified as an architect under Chapter 4703. of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.2310 - Civil immunity for architects, contractors, engineers, surveyors, and tradespersons providing volunteer services.

glossary.definition: (2) "Building inspection official" means any appointed or elected federal, state, or local official with overall executive responsibility for coordinating building inspections in the jurisdiction in which a declared emergency has occurred.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.2310 - Civil immunity for architects, contractors, engineers, surveyors, and tradespersons providing volunteer services.

glossary.definition: (3) "Construction services" includes any construction, improvement, renovation, repair, or maintenance performed by a contractor or tradesperson. "Construction services" does not include services provided by an individual who is not qualified to provide such services.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.2310 - Civil immunity for architects, contractors, engineers, surveyors, and tradespersons providing volunteer services.

glossary.definition: (4) "Contractor" has the same meaning as in section 4740.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.2310 - Civil immunity for architects, contractors, engineers, surveyors, and tradespersons providing volunteer services.

glossary.definition: (5) "Engineer" means an individual registered as a professional engineer under Chapter 4733. of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.2310 - Civil immunity for architects, contractors, engineers, surveyors, and tradespersons providing volunteer services.

glossary.definition: (6) "Law enforcement official" means an appointed or elected federal, state, or local official responsible for coordinating law enforcement in the jurisdiction in which a declared emergency has occurred.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.2310 - Civil immunity for architects, contractors, engineers, surveyors, and tradespersons providing volunteer services.

glossary.definition: (7) "Professional services" means architectural, engineering, or surveying services provided by an architect, engineer, or surveyor, respectively. "Professional services" does not include services provided by an individual who is not qualified to provide such services.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.2310 - Civil immunity for architects, contractors, engineers, surveyors, and tradespersons providing volunteer services.

glossary.definition: (8) "Public official" means any elected federal, state, or local official with overall executive responsibility in the jurisdiction in which a declared emergency has occurred.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.2310 - Civil immunity for architects, contractors, engineers, surveyors, and tradespersons providing volunteer services.

glossary.definition: (9) "Public safety official" means any appointed or elected official with overall executive responsibility to coordinate public safety in the jurisdiction in which a declared emergency has occurred.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.2310 - Civil immunity for architects, contractors, engineers, surveyors, and tradespersons providing volunteer services.

glossary.definition: (10) "Surveyor" means an individual who is registered as a professional surveyor under Chapter 4733. of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.2310 - Civil immunity for architects, contractors, engineers, surveyors, and tradespersons providing volunteer services.

glossary.definition: (11) "Tradesperson" has the same meaning as in section 4740.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.2310 - Civil immunity for architects, contractors, engineers, surveyors, and tradespersons providing volunteer services.
